verdict: SoFi posted record net revenue of $1.4B, up 44%, and net income of $241M — its 12th straight profitable quarter — as lending revenue jumped 66% and a record 1.2 million new members joined.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted, vs $0.11 a year ago; adjusted EPS also $0.18

kpis.label: Members
kpis.note: +35% YoY — a record 1.2M added in the quarter

segments.name: Interest income
segments.note: Interest earned on loans and securities — up 51% as average interest-earning assets grew 51% and funding costs fell.

segments.name: Loan origination & platform fees
segments.note: Fees for originating loans and for loans originated for third-party partners — up 32%; loan origination fees alone rose 158% on personal loan growth.

segments.name: Crypto transaction revenue
segments.note: Revenue from crypto trading, relaunched in late 2025 — almost all of it goes straight back out as the cost of buying the crypto.

segments.name: Technology products & solutions
segments.note: Fees from the Galileo technology platform that powers other fintechs — down 38% after a large client left the platform; up 18% excluding that client.

segments.name: Other noninterest income
segments.note: Interchange, brokerage and other fees — up 68%, with interchange up 77% on $31B of annualized card and Money spend.

flow.costPlain: What SoFi pays to fund itself — $414M of interest on deposits, securitizations and borrowings — plus $160M it pays to buy the crypto it sells to members.

opex.name: Provision for credit losses
opex.note: Money set aside for loans that may not be repaid — up 60% YoY as the loan book grew.

opex.name: Technology and product development
opex.note: Building the app, the bank platform and new products.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Advertising and brand building to win members — the biggest running cost, up 55% YoY.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company: finance, legal, risk and offices.

follow100Note: SoFi headlines total net revenue ($1.39B), which is already net of funding costs — the chart starts from gross revenue ($1.96B) so the funding cost is visible. The rows before 'Kept as profit' add to $12.29 of profit per $100; the $0.01 gap is rounding. SoFi reports no other income or expense.

takeaways.title: Lending is the engine
takeaways.text: Lending segment net revenue jumped 66% to $821M. Net interest income rose 57%, loan origination fees rose 158% on personal loan growth, and the Loan Platform Business originated $3.8B of loans for third parties, adding $153M to adjusted net revenue.

takeaways.title: Members are arriving in record numbers
takeaways.text: SoFi added a record 1.2 million members in the quarter, taking the total to 17.1 million (+35% YoY). Deposits grew $5.8B in the quarter to $51.3B, and Financial Services products rose 44% to 23.2 million.

takeaways.title: Crypto is huge and nearly profitless
takeaways.text: Crypto transaction revenue of $162M cost $160M to deliver, netting just $1.6M — the same pattern as Block's bitcoin. Technology Platform revenue also fell 24% after a large client left, though it grew 18% excluding that client.

oneTimers: GAAP net revenue of $1,385M includes a $14M non-cash change in the value of loan servicing rights; SoFi's adjusted net revenue of $1,371M excludes it. Adjusted net income was $243M vs GAAP net income of $241M.
otherDetail: SoFi reports no other income or expense line — income before income taxes is operating income. Adjusted net revenue was $1,371M after excluding a $14M non-cash servicing-rights valuation change.
footerNote: SoFi reports total net revenue — interest income minus funding costs. The chart starts from gross revenue ($1.96B) so the $414M paid to depositors and lenders shows as a direct cost; the bar after direct costs is SoFi's reported $1.39B total net revenue.
pngFooterNote: Gross revenue shown so funding costs are visible.
